info.title: Workflow Platform Public API
info.description: Public control-plane contract. Tenant identity is derived exclusively from the authenticated OIDC context.

get.summary: Get a workflow draft and publication summary

put.summary: Replace a workflow draft using optimistic concurrency

post.summary: Validate the current or supplied draft without publishing
Clone the current draft or one immutable version into a new draft

get.summary: Export the current draft or one immutable version as a portable bundle

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Published version; omit to export the current draft.

post.summary: Import a portable bundle into a new draft with explicit resource mappings

get.summary: List node instances using a stable keyset cursor

200.description: Node instance page without raw payloads

get.summary: List execution attempts using a stable keyset cursor

200.description: Execution attempt page with redacted failures and payload references

post.summary: Append a redacted operator note to a dead letter
Redispatch a dead letter through a new failed-node replay

get.summary: List human tasks visible to the caller

post.summary: Approve, reject, or transfer a human task

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Opaque key scoped to authenticated tenant, operation, and target resource.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Strong ETag returned by the latest draft read or write.

ETag.description: Strong representation revision used with If-Match.

RetryAfter.description: Delay in seconds for retryable 429 or 503 responses.

ProblemResponse.description: RFC 9457 problem response; status and stable code identify the failure.
